notes: Versioned MiMo TTS synthesis config (spec 5.8). The default provider is Xiaomi MiMo mimo-v2.5-tts with the preset English voice 'Mia'; the provider seam (src/tts/provider.ts) allows later replacement. synthesis_config_version participates in the cache key together with provider+model+voice+normalized text, so any change here re-synthesizes and re-runs the deterministic audio gate. duration_bounds compute the lenient per-asset duration band from the text length. audio_gate is consumed verbatim by the Python worker lexiloop_media.audio (deterministic checks only: no ASR, no audio read-back). The API key is read ONLY from the local environment (MIMO_API_KEY, legacy mimo-key) and is never logged, stored, or committed.
